name: Claims Lodgement Officer redirects non-claims inquiries

chat_history.message: I need to change the address on my policy.

success_condition: The agent must redirect the caller to 1300 943 690 for policy changes, and ask if they also have a new claim to lodge.

success_examples.response: For policy changes, please call our standard support line on 1300 943 690 — they'll be able to help. Is there anything else about lodging a new claim I can assist with?
I can't help with policy changes here, but our team on 1300 943 690 can. Do you also have a new claim to lodge?

failure_examples.response: Sure, I can help you update your policy address. What's your new address?
